name: GoTo Webinar
description: GoTo Webinar is a hosted webinar platform for scheduling live, broadcast, simulive, series, sequence, and on-demand events with registration, panelists, engagement, email, recordings, and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Connect a GoTo organizer through Relay-owned rotating OAuth with only identity and collaboration scopes, then inspect one fixed first page and time window of content-free webinar schedule and experience metadata.

credentialRequirements.name: GOTO_WEBINAR_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Relay GoTo Webinar OAuth client ID

credentialRequirements.name: GOTO_WEBINAR_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Relay GoTo Webinar OAuth client secret

capabilities.label: Read webinar lifecycle
capabilities.description: Inspect a bounded content-free webinar schedule and experience summary for the authenticated organizer.

approvalRequired.label: List webinar lifecycle
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded page of content-free webinar lifecycle metadata for the authenticated organizer.

blocked.label: Webinar identity and content
blocked.description: Webinar keys and IDs, subjects, descriptions, registration URLs, passwords, organizer/co-organizer identity, account keys, recording assets, and raw records are not returned.

blocked.label: People and engagement
blocked.description: Registrants, attendees, panelists, organizers, join links, registration fields and answers, questions, polls, surveys, attendance, and engagement are not exposed.

blocked.label: Media and communications
blocked.description: Recordings, transcripts, audio details, livestreams, emails, invitations, reminders, follow-ups, certificates, webhooks, and communications are not exposed.

blocked.label: Changes and raw API
blocked.description: Scheduling, copying, updating, cancelling, registration, people, media, webhook, and every other mutation plus arbitrary paths, IDs, filters, dates, pages, origins, bodies, and tokens are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every authenticated-organizer webinar lifecycle read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected lifecycle reads run without Relay per-action approval while authenticated-organizer binding, fixed origins, endpoint, time window, first page, bounds, redaction, audits, OAuth scopes, licensing, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware content-free GoTo Webinar lifecycle tool and refreshes the organizer grant server-side.
Railway mounts one approval-aware content-free GoTo Webinar lifecycle tool and refreshes the organizer grant server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must register a GoTo OAuth client with only identity:scim.me and collab:, configure the exact Railway callback and encrypted secret, and authorize an organizer with an eligible GoTo Webinar subscription.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register and review the Relay client, configure Railway credentials, authorize a representative organizer, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous reads, verify conditional refresh-token replacement and local disconnect, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance.

evidence.supports: GoTo documents the v2 authenticated-organizer webinar list, required from/to range, zero-based page, size limit, lifecycle fields, broad adjacent surfaces, and collab: authentication scope.
GoTo documents confidential authorization-code OAuth, one-hour access tokens, refresh tokens, returned scope/principal metadata, client-managed scopes, and the current authentication origin.
GoTo documents refresh-token use and conditional replacement, requiring Relay to preserve the existing refresh token unless a new one is returned.
